propositions: reconcile_check.py performs vendor-shape comparisons using by-path loads of Jira-specific modules (outbound_fields.py, adf.py) instead of the canonical backend mapper, violating backend neutrality

assignee matching, description ADF normalization, and status/priority unwrapping should be canonicalized by applying InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local to the snapshot entry once, then comparing in local vocabulary

the by-path loader pattern in reconcile_check.py (via _load_sibling with string literals) cannot be caught by AST-import detection alone and requires both an AST case and a source-text case asserting no adapters/jira/ path literal

description comparison must use OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote for ADF fitting without emitting logger warnings, then compare with rstrip tolerance via _text_matches parity, not FieldSanitizer.sanitize_description
the neutrality gate carve-out for reconcile_check must be removed and coverage extended to detect any adapters.jira import or by-path vendor sibling load
annotation-label status precedence (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled) is an intended correctness improvement where canonical comparison now matches the inbound differ's real dispatch logic
